$comment: Season English – API contract (front-end → back-end). Describes every data entity the front-end stores today in localStorage (key `aec:v1`) with a real sample, plus the REST endpoints the FE expects. Samples were extracted from the app's demo data (seedDemo) and sanitised. Dates: ISO-8601 UTC for timestamps, `YYYY-MM-DD` for calendar dates. Ids are opaque strings (prefix_random).
generatedFrom: core.js (seedDemo, DEMO_LESSONS, demoLevelForm, TEST_FORMS, GAME_POOL) + logic-v2/useAppLogicV2.ts (AppState)

conventions.auth: Bearer JWT in Authorization header. Roles: learner | operator | manager. Learners may only read/write their own records; operators manage learners; managers manage everything (incl. restore/purge of deleted accounts).
conventions.pagination: List endpoints accept ?limit&cursor and return { items: [], nextCursor: string|null }. Current FE loads everything (≤ 15 learners/month), so unpaginated responses are acceptable in v1.

mockDataSources.seedDemo: core.js → seedDemo(): 7 learners (A1–B2, 2 unplaced), 1 operator, 1 manager; 2 weeks; 4 approved lesson sets; placement tests; activity/progress; coach sessions; 1 submission; 2 approved level-up forms; 1 level-up test + challenge + pending request. All learner PINs = 1234.
mockDataSources.DEMO_LESSONS: core.js → DEMO_LESSONS + DEMO_VI/DEMO_UMB/DEMO_LEX: 5 hand-written lessons per level A1/A2/B1/B2 in the standard structure (demoLessons(cefr)).
mockDataSources.demoLevelForm: core.js → demoLevelForm(target): sample level-up forms for B2 and C1.
mockDataSources.TEST_FORMS: core.js → TEST_FORMS.A / .B: the two fixed placement/final test forms (static content, ships with FE; BE may host them under GET /test-forms/:id).
mockDataSources.GAME_POOL: core.js → GAME_POOL: fallback distractor words for mini games when a set has no `others`.
mockDataSources.AI_fallbacks: Without an AI key the FE still works: placement is scored by length heuristics (writing/speaking ≤ 60%), lessons must be approved by hand, practice is key-matched.

Settings.description: Org-wide configuration (one record). Secrets (apiKey, geminiKey, oaiKey, pexelsKey, pixabayKey) must move server-side when BE proxies AI; never return them to learners.

notes.theme: auto | summer | spring | autumn | winter | tet | midautumn | christmas
notes.prompts: map promptKey → overridden system prompt (keys: base, placement, lesson, weeks, mgrade, coach, grade, levelform, gamevocab)
notes.bgm.url: YouTube video/playlist link chosen by operator; empty = default playlist

User.description: Account. Learners carry level, profile, persona, rewards bookkeeping. `pin` is a 4–6 digit learner PIN (store hashed server-side; managers can see role PINs).

sample.name: Học viên A
sample.monthlyGoal: Tự giới thiệu bằng 5 câu đơn giản.

profile.situations: Đọc ticket và trả lời ngắn cho dev nước ngoài

notes.pendingCefr: {from,to,by,reason,evidence,effective:'YYYY-MM-DD'} – deferred level change applied on the next Monday

Week.description: Weekly topic framework (one per pilot week). `plan` = per-level 5-day plan from the AI suggestion, used when generating lessons.

sample.description: Tự giới thiệu trong buổi họp đầu với khách hoặc đồng nghiệp mới.
sample.objectives: Nói/viết 4–6 câu về bản thân và công việc.
sample.keyVocabHint: colleague, in charge of, department, deadline

LessonSet.description: 5 micro-lessons (Mon→Fri) for one week × one CEFR level. Learners only see status=approved sets of their level.

Lesson.description: Standard structure: 3 vocabulary words (+3 phrases, pos, family, umbrella, syn/ant; B1+: synAll, slang, poetic), grammar theory + examples, pronunciation drill (1 sound + 3 verified words), 4 skills (listening L, reading R, writing practice W, speaking S) + word-class C and word-use U quizzes, Vietnamese translations per part. Every MCQ has exactly 4 English options, one correct; place names are never options.

sample.title: I am + name / job
sample.objective: Nói được tên và nghề của mình bằng 2 câu.
sample.theory: 1) Công thức: I am + tên / I am a + nghề (am = là; a = một). 2) Dùng khi tự giới thiệu. 3) Ví dụ: My name is Lan. (Tên tôi là Lan.) I am a tester. (Tôi là nhân viên kiểm thử.) This is my job. (Đây là công việc của tôi.)

slang.def: a job, especially a temporary one
slang.example: I got a new gig as a tester.

pron.tip: Mở miệng nói 'e' rồi lướt nhanh sang 'i'.

listening.audio: Hello. My name is Lan. I am a tester at GFT.

reading.text: Hi, I am Nam. I am a designer. My job is fun.

speaking.answer: My name is Lan and I am a tester.

wordclass.prompt: "This is my job." – What part of speech is "job" in this sentence?

S.a: Tên tôi là Lan và tôi là nhân viên kiểm thử.

C.q: Từ "job" trong câu này thuộc từ loại nào?

U.a: Tôi có một công việc mới.

Progress.description: A completed lesson (one per user × lesson; reviews increment `reviews`).

Activity.description: One row per learning action per day (drives streaks, attendance, reminders).

PracticeResult.description: Result of one exercise part. Key = `${userId}_${lessonId}` for W, `${userId}_${lessonId}~${code}` for L/R/C/U/S, `…~P` for the pronunciation drill ({drilled:[words]}). Max 2 attempts; `done` = correct or out of attempts; `manual` set when an operator upheld an appeal.

AudioFile.description: Recordings (speaking test tasks, lesson speaking part). FE keeps them in IndexedDB today; BE should accept multipart upload and return the id used in PracticeResult.audio / Test.audio.

CoachSession.description: Chat with the AI coach 'Season' for a week. `week` negative = archived (cleared) chat whose turns still count. `challenge` present = level-up challenge (6 turns at target level).

messages.content: Hi B! I'm Season. What do you do at work?
My name is B. I work at marketing.
Nice to meet you, B! What do you do in marketing every day?

turns.userText: My name is B. I work at marketing.
turns.reply: Nice to meet you, B! What do you do in marketing every day?

Submission.description: Weekly (Friday) practice: writing or dialogue, graded by AI or by hand (meaning 40% · vocab 30% · grammar 30%).

sample.task: Write a short paragraph or email (80–120 words) about "Introducing yourself & your job", including one problem and one suggestion.
sample.feedback: Clear structure and a concrete suggestion.

Test.description: Placement / final / level-up test result. Listening & reading auto-scored; writing (5 criteria ×1–5 → scaled to section max) and speaking (4 criteria) by AI or operator. Total /100 → CEFR: 0–24 A1 · 25–44 A2 · 45–64 B1 · 65–84 B2 · 85–100 C1.

sample.rationale: Hiểu thông tin cơ bản phần A nghe/đọc; bài viết rất ngắn, thiếu động từ to be.

warnings.reason: chuyển tab hoặc thu nhỏ cửa sổ

TestDraft.description: Unfinished test attempt, keyed `${userId}:${kind}`; the per-section clock keeps running while away.

TestForm.description: A test paper (built-in A/B or AI-generated level-up form). MCQ `answer` is the option index; `pts` per question. Writing: `tasks[]` (new) or single task (old); speaking: `tasks[]` with optional data `table`.

parts.title: Part A – Thông báo của quản lý
parts.instruction: Listen to the manager's announcement and answer questions 1–5.

questions.q: What time is the team meeting?

tasks.title: Task 1 – Phản hồi nhanh (7 phút · 7 điểm · A2–B1)
tasks.task: You receive this message from a colleague:

LevelForm.description: AI-generated short level-up test for a target level; one approved form per target.

sample.form: <TestForm with listening.parts[0] (5×5 pts), reading.parts[0] (5×5 pts), writing 80–120 words, speaking.tasks[0]; optional `short:true` flag>

LevelRequest.description: Learner passed level-up test + Season challenge; waits for operator decision. Approval = deferred level change (next Monday).

Reminder.description: Learner missed ≥2 consecutive days; manager sends via Base.vn webhook or copies the text.

Appeal.description: Learner disputes an AI grade (exercise part or weekly submission); operator upholds or rejects.

DeleteRequest.description: Maker-checker: operator requests, manager approves → account moves to Trash (restorable) until purged.

TrashItem.description: Deleted account with all of its data (per-entity arrays), restorable by a manager.

PinReport.description: Operator forgot the role PIN; manager sees current PINs and marks done.

TopicReport.description: Learner entered 3 invalid/banned mini-game topics in a row; operator reviews.

inputs.reason: Chủ đề trông không có nghĩa – nhập lại nhé

Survey.description: End-of-pilot satisfaction (opens after the final test).

MicroLesson.description: Learner's own extra one-lesson practice generated by AI (same shape as Lesson + ownership and result fields).

GameSet.description: Vocabulary set for mini games (AI from a free topic, or this week's lesson words). `others` = unrelated distractors.

words.def: a hot drink made from beans

GameResult.description: One play of a game. Arena points = best % per game + 50 per duel won (B1+ only).

Duel.description: 1-v-1 challenge between two B1+ learners on the same game and word set; higher % wins, tie = draw.

endpoints.notes: First login with no PIN sets it.

long-running AI job (15 s – 3 min); consider 202 + polling /jobs/:id

endpoints.response: learnerHome() payload: week, topic, lessons, next lesson, dots, stats, levelSignal, levelUpState

endpoints.notes: key = lessonId or lessonId~L/R/C/U/S; W free-text and non-keyed answers go to AI (prompt `mgrade`)
curt messages (<3 words) are answered locally without AI; daily cap per learner
server scores L/R, calls AI for W/S (prompt `placement`), evaluates level-up outcome
validateTopic first (strikes → TopicReport), then AI prompt `gamevocab`; 422 with {reason, soft} when rejected

aiCalls.description: Today the browser calls the provider directly (Claude Messages API with `anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access`, Gemini generateContent, or any OpenAI-compatible chat/completions). The back-end should proxy these with the same system prompts (core.js PROMPTS / SCHEMAS or logic-v2 exports) and JSON schemas so responses stay identical.
tasks: lesson (5 micro-lessons per week/level; split in halves on free tiers; per-lesson quality gate + retry)
coach (one chat turn: reply + rubric + suggestions + usedWords + relevance)
gamevocab (12 words + 8 distractors from a free topic, with topic validation)
enrich (vocabulary details for an existing lesson)
transcribe (speech-to-text for speaking answers; Gemini inline audio or OpenAI /audio/transcriptions)
